facts.fact: Carson 说那件事（她亲了 Beau Jones）跟着她绕了三天，进奶棚、吃饭、睡觉都在回放。
facts.anchor: That fact had been following me around for three days.

facts.fact: Carson 在第一次装义肢前，有六周时间没有左腿的重量。
facts.anchor: I had spent six weeks without the weight of my left leg before my first fitting.

facts.fact: 事故前 Carson 二十岁，确信整个人生都在等着她：rodeo、赞助商、旅行、婚姻、孩子、Marigold。
facts.anchor: I’d been twenty and convinced my entire life was waiting for me.

facts.fact: Carson 为了避开 Beau，周日记牛奶记录，周一花不必要的大量时间检查西牧场。
周三晚上七点，Carson 坐在 Spicy Pumpkin Tavern，纳闷 Rosie Malone 怎么说服她离家出门。
facts.anchor: By seven that night, I was sitting at the Spicy Pumpkin Tavern wondering how Rosie Malone had convinced me to leave my house on a Wednesday.

facts.fact: Beau 把三块旧木牌的照片发给 Carson（其中一块是 Pops 潦草字迹的招牌），Carson 让他只清洁、别重漆。
facts.anchor: Three wooden signs leaned against the garage wall.

facts.fact: Gerald 告诉 Carson，他是在丰收节遇见 Jinny 的，那是五十一年前。
Gerald 说他与 Jinny 共度了四十二年，说那已经够本。
facts.anchor: I had forty-two years with her.
